release_notes_description: We're constantly enhancing Bobby's AI-driven architecture tools to better serve your creative vision. Each update brings new capabilities, performance improvements, and refinements based on your feedback.
alpha_launch_subTitle: Welcome to the first alpha release of Bobby AI! We're excited to have you test our platform designed specifically for architectural visualization. This early version includes our core AI models and basic functionality to revolutionize your design workflow.
available_features_text_1: Transform your architectural sketches into detailed visualizations. Our AI converts hand-drawn plans or digital outlines into realistic renderings while preserving your original design intent. As this feature is in BETA, we're particularly interested in your feedback on accuracy and design fidelity.
available_features_text_2: Create architectural visualizations using descriptive text alone. Simply input your design concept, preferred materials, and environmental context to generate high-quality images that match your creative vision. Experiment with different prompts to discover the full capabilities.
available_features_text_3: Generate new architectural visualizations inspired by your reference photos. This tool allows you to create variations with similar design language while exploring different styles and compositions. Perfect for expanding on existing concepts or remaining built works.
available_features_text_4: Enhance the resolution and details of your architectural images. This tool sharpens features and improves clarity without distortion, making your visuals presentation-ready. Ideal for refining rough concepts or preparing images for client presentations.
available_features_text_5: Make targeted modifications to your architectural visualizations. Change materials, adjust lighting, or alter specific elements while maintaining overall image consistency. This BETA feature provides a foundation for more sophisticated editing capabilities in future releases.
coming_soon_text_1: We're working on a specialized tool to transform 2D elevation drawings into photorealistic visualizations. Soon you'll be able to upload technical facade plans and let our AI generate detailed architectural renderings with accurate materials and proportions.
known_limitations_items_1: Generation times may vary depending on server load
known_limitations_items_2: Some complex architectural details might require additional refinement
known_limitations_items_3: Limited number of architectural styles currently supported
known_limitations_items_5: Maximum resolution constraints on all models
feedback_text_1: As an alpha tester, your input is invaluable! Please use the feedback button within the app to report any bugs, share your experiences, or suggest improvements. We're particularly interested in:
feedback_text_2: Thank you for helping us build the future of architectural visualization. Together, we're making AI accessible to designers worldwide.
